title: Existence of normalized additive Cech comparisons
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $I$ a set and $U_i$ an open cover of $X$. There exists a normalized additive Cech comparison system [def-pc-cech-comparison-system] on $U$: natural transformations in all abelian sheaves, with the stated degree-zero gluing normalization and connecting-map law for short exact sequences surjective on all tuple intersections.

source.place: Lemma 20.11.2, normalization and boundary compatibility of the augmented double-complex map

proof.text: Prove the actual section augmentation quasi-isomorphism for every injective resolution, then apply objectwise canonical comparison existence to each abelian sheaf. All data choices occur inside this existential theorem, never inside a definition.
Use canonical coefficient naturality to assemble the chosen objectwise maps into natural transformations. Prove their degree-zero equality componentwise from the objectwise normalization.
Use the canonical endpoint boundary law on each short exact sequence surjective on tuple sections. Package comparison, zero, and connecting as CechComparisonSystem.

proof_origin.place: Explicit abelian alpha/beta construction, proved section augmentation, and three strictly smaller comparison statements; Lean packaging by K3
